description: Remove someone from the workspace. They immediately lose access to every form, response, and setting in it, and getting back in means a fresh invitation. `confirm` must be their EMAIL exactly as fillo_list_members shows it — not their member id. Ask the human to confirm the email before calling. Needs members:manage.

confirm.description: The exact member email address, typed to authorize this irreversible action. Ask the human to confirm it first — do not fill this in from context on your own.

member.description: Member id or email from fillo_list_members.

name: fillo_remove_member
title: Remove a workspace member
